Questions coaches ask us

Who is Pushup for?

Pushup by Gritta AI works with fitness coaches, personal trainers, yoga teachers, run clubs and small studios that want more clients without more admin.

What does Pushup actually do?

We build and run the four parts of a coaching business that bring in clients: sales systems, marketing, automations and the website that ties them together.

Do I need all four services?

No. Most coaches start with the part that is holding them back most, often follow-up or the website, and add the rest when it makes sense.

How do we get started?

Book a free strategy call. We look at your offer, funnel and follow-up, and show you the first three things we would change.
